Challenges

Sound familiar?

“We bought links before and got burned.”

Cheap link packages leave footprints — and cleanups cost more than the links did. We audit the damage first, then rebuild authority with placements that survive scrutiny.

“Our competitors outrank us with half our content.”

That is usually an authority gap, not a content gap. The gap analysis shows exactly which publications and topics drive their advantage.

“Agencies keep offering us “DA 90” links that do nothing.”

Domain metrics are not rankings. We vet placements on relevance, real traffic and editorial standards — and report every link live.

“We’re scared of a Google penalty.”

Reasonable — penalties come from bought, scaled, manipulative links. Earned coverage and citations carry no such risk profile.

“Our content is good but nobody links to it.”

Linkable assets are built deliberately: data stories, tools and expert commentary that publishers actually want to cite.

“Outreach emails get ignored.”

Journalists ignore templates. Our pitches lead with a story or dataset relevant to their beat, personalised per publication.

“We can’t tell what our link budget bought.”

Every placement is reported live with the target page, anchor and context — no screenshots of spreadsheets, no vanished links.

“Links we earned keep disappearing.”

We monitor placements and chase removals; earned editorial links also tend to stick because they were placed for readers, not algorithms.

Why brands trust our link building

Zero bought links

No PBNs, no link farms, no paid placements disguised as outreach. Every link is earned through stories, data and relationships.

Digital PR, not link schemes

Campaigns are built around data stories and expert commentary that journalists want — coverage first, links as the by-product.

Vetted placements only

Relevance, real traffic and editorial standards are checked per publication before a pitch is ever sent.

Gap-led strategy

Your profile is benchmarked against the competitors who outrank you, so effort goes where the authority gap actually is.

Transparent live reporting

Placements are reported as they go live, with target pages and anchors visible — you can verify every link yourself.

Built to survive updates

Earned authority does not depend on loopholes, so algorithm updates are weather reports, not emergencies.

How It Works

Why earned links are the only links worth having

Bought links work until they don't — and the cleanup costs more than the links did. Search engines reward authority that is genuinely earned: coverage, citations and references from sites that chose to link to you.

We earn those links with digital PR, data stories, expert commentary and targeted outreach to publishers in your market — every placement vetted for relevance and quality before it goes live.

FAQs

FAQs on link building services

How many links will we get per month?

Quality beats quotas — campaigns typically earn a steady flow of relevant placements; your proposal sets realistic targets from your market's data.

Are the links permanent?

Earned editorial links are as permanent as links get — they exist because the publisher values the content.

Do you guarantee specific sites?

We target tiers and relevance, and report every placement live. Anyone guaranteeing specific publications is usually buying them.

Is this safe for a penalised site?

Yes — earned links are the replacement strategy we use in penalty recovery programs.

Are your links white-hat?

Yes — earned editorial placements only. No purchases, no exchanges at scale, no private blog networks. If a tactic would embarrass you in a manual review, we do not use it.

Do you report links before or after they go live?

As they go live. Your report shows the publication, the live URL, the target page and the anchor for every placement.
